measured_facts.notif_centre_has_no_tabs: modules/centre/NotifCentre.qml is ~704 lines and is a SINGLE pane: header band (count capsule + clear-all icon) -> history region (grouped ListView over NotifGroup) -> pinned footer. There is no tab bar and no SwipeView. A News tab means introducing a tab structure into the centre, not just adding a view.
measured_facts.tab_precedent_exists_elsewhere: The dashboard uses TabBar + SwipeView with synchronized tabs — reuse that idiom rather than inventing one. See modules/Dashboard.qml.
measured_facts.layer_surface_rule: CRITICAL, learned the hard way in quick task 260818-nwo: a top-anchored layer surface is compositor-centred, so ANY surface resize drags the content sideways and re-buffers every frame. The dashboard drawer was made a never-resizing full-screen surface with ALL motion in QML. NotifCentre is also a layer surface — do not let a new tab change its geometry.
measured_facts.centre_summon: IPC target `notifs` exposes toggleCentre(); the centre also owns its own open()/close()/toggle() verbs (D-19-16).
measured_facts.backend_pattern: Fenced backends live in modules/dashboard/ and are mounted in shell.qml as siblings of dashboardLoader (D-14), gated by a drawerOpen-style property for zero idle footprint (D-32). WeatherBackend.qml is the reference for: watched state FileView + JsonAdapter, unwatched atomicWrites cache FileView, coordsValid-style input validation, try/catch + explicit shape check on every parse, and a D-41 widgetState register.
measured_facts.one_host_per_file: Network hosts are fenced one-per-file. WeatherBackend owns Open-Meteo; GeocodeBackend owns Nominatim. A feed fetcher must own its host in its own file, and the fence is verified by grep.
measured_facts.qml_traps_hit_this_session: 1) Declare members ABOVE any construction-time call site or they throw 'is not a function'. 2) A child's binding to a parent property is NOT updated inside the parent's own onXChanged — use Qt.callLater. 3) Guards that return silently make total failure look like a plausible wrong answer — log them.
measured_facts.logs: quickshell journals NOTHING. All QML warnings and console.log go to ~/.cache/quickshell.log (the launcher's sink). journalctl --user -u quickshell is empty.
measured_facts.drive_the_ui: hyprctl dispatch global <name> FAILS under this repo's Lua config. Use: hyprctl dispatch 'hl.dsp.global("quickshell:notif-centre")'
measured_facts.gates: quickshell-doctor 28/0, colour-lint 146/0, motion-lint 293/0, theme-doctor 586/0, theme-parity 1721/1721, stow-link-check. quickshell-doctor probes the LIVE shell and reads flaky for seconds after a QML hot reload — re-run before believing a failure.
measured_facts.colour_and_motion: colour-lint rejects hardcoded colours in QML (read Colours.qml); motion-lint rejects raw durations (read Motion.qml).

open_design_questions: Which feed format(s) — RSS, Atom, JSON Feed? QML has no XML feed parser; XmlListModel exists but its capabilities on this quickshell build are UNVERIFIED and must be measured before planning.
Which sources ship as defaults, and does the dropdown allow user-added sources?
Where the source list is stored — a new engine-owned state file needs registering in theme-engine/contract.json (that 'seeded but unregistered' bug class has recurred 8 times in this repo).
